Page/sub-app and URL: Shared account cookie — site/assets/js/crown-account.js; evinca lib/auth.ts
Evidence and reproduction steps: The full Supabase session JSON (access and refresh tokens) is written by JavaScript to cookies hca-auth.0..n with Domain=.healthcarecrownacademy.co.uk and Max-Age=31536000. Learner impact: A script injection on any subdomain, or any subdomain served by a third party, could take over learner accounts for up to a year.
Recommended fix: Keep the refresh token out of JS-readable storage: issue an HttpOnly, Secure, host-scoped cookie from an account-site endpoint and hand apps short-lived access tokens via a token endpoint. Shorten lifetime. Restrict *.healthcarecrownacademy.co.uk to hosts you operate and audit DNS for dangling records. Self-host Lumen's CDN dependencies or add SRI.
Acceptance criteria: No cookie readable by document.cookie contains a refresh token; a DNS inventory lists only company-operated hosts; Lumen CSP has no third-party script origins.
Status (26 Oct 2026): Needs your approval (larger design change); see prompt B7

Page/sub-app and URL: Gulf Nursing / SNLE bank — all 1,350 items
Evidence and reproduction steps: Scripted analysis of the preserved bank: the keyed option is the longest option in 1,068/1,350 items (79%; chance is about 25%). In 65 items the key is the only option without a final full stop. 1,100 items (81%) can be answered from one of these two cues without clinical knowledge. Many distractors are implausible (e.g., Q1008 'Recommend punishment…', Q1014 'rest in the sun').
Learner impact: Scores overstate readiness, and learners can learn test-wise habits that fail on the real exam. Any 'readiness' or progress indicator built on these scores is unreliable.
Recommended fix: Rewrite options to parallel length, grammar and punctuation; replace implausible distractors with common misconceptions; add item analysis (difficulty, discrimination) once usage data exists; lint the bank in CI for length and punctuation cues.
Acceptance criteria: Key-is-longest falls below 35%; the punctuation cue appears in 0 items; a CI lint reports both metrics on each content release.
Status (26 Oct 2026): Measured by script (apps/snle/scripts/item-checks.mjs); rewriting needs item writers
